name: capture-learning-tools
description: "Turn technical conversations, bugs, CI failures, review comments, and repeated agent mistakes into durable project improvements. This skill is for both non-technical and technical users: it explains the learning in plain English, inspects the repository, chooses the right prevention layer, proposes changes first, and only edits pro
